Both test classes pass (12 + 12 = 24 tests).

## Summary

After 5 prior refactor iterations, the file was already in good shape (constants extracted, reflection helpers consolidated, `appendStatLine` helpers, restructured `addValue`/`getStandardDeviation`/`setWindowSize`). The only remaining substantive improvement was in `getPercentile`:

**Change**: Extracted a private helper `setPercentileQuantile(double p)` from `getPercentile`. The two branches (direct cast for the built-in `Percentile`, reflective dispatch otherwise) both serve the single semantic concern "set the quantile on the configured implementation". After the extraction, `getPercentile` reads as `setPercentileQuantile(p); return apply(percentileImpl);` — symmetric with the other statistic getters that delegate to `apply(impl)`, and giving the optimization-vs-reflection dispatch one named home.

No public API changes; behavior (including exception types and order) is preserved. Verified by compilation and running the `DescriptiveStatisticsTest` + `SynchronizedDescriptiveStatisticsTest` suites (24 tests, all passing).
